Enable or disable the tabs above the Studio canvas.

## CLI flag

Use `--disable-canvas-tabs` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                               | Flag                    |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio) | `--disable-canvas-tabs` |

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setCanvasTabsEnabled(false);
```
